 Zee 5 brings Prince Mishra on board as senior vice president of creative
 The former Prime Video creative lead will focus on strengthening the brand and audience connections
 Published
 9 hours ago on
 November 6, 2026 
 By
 indiantelevision.com Team 
 Follow us on Google News 
 Follow us on WhatsApp 
 Share 
 Tweet 
 MUMBAI: Zee 5 is adding a new creative chapter to its growth story, appointing Prince Mishra as senior vice president of creative. Mishra announced his new role through a LinkedIn post, marking a move after an eight-year stint across MX Player and Prime Video.
 At Zee 5, Mishra will focus on strengthening the platform’s brand identity, building deeper consumer affinity and creating more meaningful connections between its content and audiences. He also highlighted the opportunity to work with the breadth of Zee 5’s content portfolio as the streaming platform looks to shape its next phase of growth.
 In his announcement, Mishra thanked Tejkarran Singh Bajaj for the opportunity and expressed enthusiasm about working with the Zee 5 team. He described the move as the beginning of a new creative journey, with an emphasis on building the brand and strengthening its relationship with viewers.
 The appointment comes after a substantial stint within the Amazon entertainment ecosystem, where Mishra spent eight years working across MX Player, Amazon MX Player and Prime Video. His journey began at MX Player in August 2018 as a content producer, before he moved through creative producer and senior creative producer roles.
 He was subsequently elevated to head of creative at MX Player by Prime Video in September 2022, overseeing creative promotions across MX Player and MX TakaTak. His responsibilities covered brand campaigns, individual content titles and the platform’s content library.
 In September 2024, Mishra moved into the role of lead, creative, at Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios. He was responsible for the end-to-end creative and marketing mandate for advertising-supported video-on-demand (AVOD) originals and major platform launches in India.
 His work involved developing campaign strategies, creating trailers and promotional material, overseeing on-platform design and managing digital and on-ground productions. He also built and managed cross-functional creative teams spanning creative development, design and video production, while coordinating with agencies and production partners.
 Mishra’s departure marks the end of an eight-year association with the Amazon group, during which he witnessed MX Player’s evolution through several business transitions, including its integration with miniTV and subsequent journey into the Prime Video ecosystem.
 Reflecting on the experience in an earlier LinkedIn post, Mishra described the journey as one of continuous learning, experimentation and creative opportunities. He also credited the colleagues and leaders he worked with for shaping his professional growth, particularly through opportunities to take on unfamiliar responsibilities and lead major campaigns.
 Before joining MX Player, Mishra worked with Roundglass Rise, where he was part of the core team developing scripted and unscripted shows, and Shemaroo Entertainment as a senior producer. He began his media career in content production and has built experience across programming, production, creative strategy and marketing.
 An alumnus of the Indian School of Media, where he completed a postgraduate diploma in media and event management, Mishra also holds a bachelor’s degree in mass media from the University of Mumbai.
 His appointment gives Zee 5 a creative leader with experience spanning content development, platform marketing and large-scale campaign execution. As streaming services compete for audience attention in an increasingly crowded market, the challenge will be to turn that experience into stronger brand recall and closer connections with viewers.
